sourceOfTruth: GitHub issue #134 AC1 (an overlapping run leaves one run's tree end-to-end, never an interleaving; the live tree never shows a half-written state); review r0 finding r0-3

inventory.producer: writeDirAtomically (apps/pair-cli/src/registry/atomic-target.ts:171-186): exclusive stage seeded from target -> populate(stage) -> swap(stage, target)
inputs: two overlapping writeDirAtomically calls on the same target whose populate callbacks interleave
representations: live target dir (observable to readers mid-run)
consumers: doCopyAndUpdateLinks / install + update handlers (registry dir writes)
any reader of the live target during a run
classes: run A suspended mid-populate (one of two files written): live target must still be the pre tree
run B completes end-to-end while A is suspended: live target = B's whole tree
A resumes and completes last: live target = A's whole tree seeded from the pre tree (last writer wins), never one.md from B + two.md from A
interactions: A's partial populate x B's complete swap x A's later swap (the interleaving the in-place regression produces)
